subject: Atelier private dinner — runbook, privacy ops & staggered drop-off plan
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@atelier.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Atelier private dinner — runbook, privacy ops & staggered drop-off plan

Claire —

Thanks again for confirming the dinner on Thursday (Dec 2). I put together a short runbook and a first-pass guest list to make sure we align on privacy-sensitive items and the staggered drop-off plan you asked about. Key asks from our side: final dietary restrictions per guest, any legal / press embargo (we've noted Atelier prefers no press), and whether any attendees need a dedicated driver pick-up (hotel transfers).

Attached: draft_guest_list.xlsx (columns: name / title / org / arrival window / dietary note / escort required).

Current proposals in the runbook (high level):
- Arrival windows: staggered 6:00–6:45pm in three waves to keep foyer traffic light.
- Check-in: badge-only at concierge; guest list will be verified by venue security.
- Photo/media: default "no press" inside the dining room unless you say otherwise; we will enforce signage and remind staff.
- Privacy ops: we will not collect any personal IDs beyond name and company on the guest list; if you require guest IDs for the venue, please confirm and we will handle securely.
- Transport: we recommend two shuttles for overflow + pre-booked drivers for VIPs.

Can you review the attached guest list and push back any edits (especially dietary and escort requirements) by EOD Monday so we can finalize logistics with the chef and the venue? Also flag any VIPs that require private entry.

Thanks —
Dev
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft_guest_list.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Claire Thompson <claire@atelier.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@zenclient.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T13:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Atelier private dinner — runbook, privacy ops & staggered drop-off plan

Dev —

Thanks for the thorough note. Quick responses inline:

- Dietary: attached is a signed attendee ID sheet from our side with allergies noted for 4 guests (lactose, shellfish, nut). See atelier_attendee_ids.pdf.
- Press: confirmed — strict embargo. No press, no photography beyond personal phones (no live streaming). Our legal team is insistent about this.
- IDs: venue requires company badge or government ID for contractors; full-time guests can use business card. We'll supply IDs for contractors in the attached file.
- VIP pickups: Tom Rivera (CEO, ZenClient) needs a private car (arrival 6:15pm). Otherwise the shuttles are fine.

We made two small edits to your guest list (added two last-minute internal attendees). Please update final list and send to the venue with a redacted copy for security.

Best,
Claire
Director of Partnerships, Atelier AI
[Attachment: atelier_attendee_ids.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@atelier.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Atelier private dinner — runbook, privacy ops & staggered drop-off plan

Claire / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Claire. I've incorporated the attendee IDs and dietary notes into v3 of the guest list and attached the updated files for the venue. A few operational confirmations from our side:

- Seating: we will create a single-centered table plan with a short head table for speakers (Tom at 1, Claire at 2). Seating assignments will be finalized after you confirm the two internal attendees you added.
- Transport & drivers: Rishi will coordinate the private car for Tom and two additional drivers for VIP rotation. Shuttles scheduled at 5:50pm, 6:10pm, 6:30pm.
- Security & badges: venue security will check the redacted guest list at concierge. We will provide the unredacted list to security only via encrypted drive link (see Drive runbook).
- Catering: chef needs final headcount by Tuesday noon to confirm plated vs family-style. Menu options attached; chef recommends plated service for privacy and portion control.
- Photo policy: signage will be printed at the entrance and the maître d' will remind guests on arrival.

Attachments: final_guest_list_v3.xlsx, venue_floorplan.png

Next steps (who/when):
- Claire: confirm the two extra internal attendees by Monday EOD (we will block seats but not finalize name tags).
- Rishi: confirm driver names and send driver_manifest.pdf to venue by Tuesday 4pm.
- Dev: will coordinate with chef on the plated menu and confirm vegetarian/gluten-free counts by Tuesday noon.

Marissa
Sr. Events Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: final_guest_list_v3.xlsx (Excel)]
[Attachment: venue_floorplan.png (PNG)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-01T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Atelier private dinner — runbook, privacy ops & staggered drop-off plan

Quick confirmation from transport: we have secured a black car for Tom Rivera arriving 6:10pm (driver: Luis Hernandez, cell: +1-415-555-0199). Two additional drivers (surnames Patel, Nguyen) are on standby for VIP rotation; I will send a locked driver_manifest.pdf to venue security by 2026-12-01T16:00:00-08:00.

Also confirming shuttle pick-up points at Hotel Marlowe (valet lane) and a brief window for drop-offs to avoid lobby congestion — shuttles will unload at the side entrance between 6:00–6:45pm. Drivers have been briefed on the no-press policy and to refuse photo requests from anyone other than guests.

If Claire is comfortable with that, we will finalize drivers and push the redacted guest list to venue security this afternoon.

Rishi
Head of Field Ops, Redwood Inference
